historical_reviews.deepseek: Its operator gate is necessary but not sufficient for a persistent remote identity write.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly rejects arbitrary-byte mutation and adds route, target and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; IB/OOB getter and IB setter records were compared to isolate remote identity-correlation risk.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The label being changed cannot remain the sole proof of which remote controller receives the write.

original_test_intent: Set one sanctioned management-controller identifier through OOB, prove the full stored value and its consumers on the same physical BMC, then restore the original identity when required.
original_method: Retain LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x0a 0xdc and the source transport, but replace arbitrary mutation with an approved encoded string after complete baseline, immutable target binding and fallback preparation.
manual_activity: The asset/network owner approves the exact replacement string and encoding, immutable BMC anchor, affected consumers, maintenance window, fallback access and byte-exact restoration.
required_inputs: Verified BMC endpoint, firmware and immutable hardware identity
safety_requirements: Never write an arbitrary changed byte
Read back full value and consumers
Do not use the temporary label as sole reconnect identity
agent_execution_scope: Bind endpoint to immutable BMC identity
Capture complete baseline via approved getter
Read back complete identifier and consumers
engineer_actions: Approve value, target anchor, consumer impact and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level setter may be used only after raw equivalence is proven; password argv and identity-by-changed-label are unacceptable evidence gaps.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable target binding and approval, send one LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x0a 0xdc 0 0x10 <approved-data>, revalidate the same BMC independently, read back every byte and restore the baseline under the plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB path, opcode and 10/5 timing remain; the source's arbitrary data selection is not guessed or silently executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an identity-governed remote transaction anchored to immutable hardware/session evidence, with a sanctioned temporary value, full consumer checks and deterministic restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secret-safe target anchoring and a reversible semantic lifecycle in place of random byte alteration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The IB setter does not exercise LANPlus target attribution or remote evidence continuity after the visible identifier changes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing the label used by inventory or operators can cause subsequent OOB records to be attributed to the wrong asset even when the network session persists.

project_override_considerations: A vendor CLI is equivalent only if raw semantics, immutable target proof, complete read-back and consumer/restore evidence remain available.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, OOB 0x0a command and one-byte-change instruction all describe an identifier write. The data-selection method and acceptance criteria are unsafe and insufficient but not internally contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The remote identity-write operation is identifiable. Exact value, schema, approval, immutable target proof, fallback and restore are explicit prerequisites rather than irreducible blockers.

review_improvement: Prevents remote identity corruption and preserves trustworthy target attribution across the approved write, verification and rollback lifecycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: The setter changes metadata that may be used to label later evidence. Before writing, automation must anchor the controller with a different immutable identity. Afterward it must verify that same hardware, reconstruct the complete value and check downstream consumers, otherwise a successful command could corrupt both inventory and audit attribution.
